importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends ERISA to require the Employee Benefit Security Administration to submit annual reports to Congress regarding adverse interest agreements and collaboration with plaintiff attorneys, while establishing a statutory policy to promote voluntary pension plan sponsorship.
